journey.name: wear send offline error
journey.description:
The app pays only online: a payment link opened while the watch is offline ends on its own refusal, a crossed-out cloud and "Can't pay offline" with the reject haptic and OK, before any review or hold (docs/wear.md › Send › Offline). OK closes the flow, and the request is dropped: it is not paid when the network returns. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, turn on airplane mode in its settings).
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack with a balance above 0, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. Offline recipe: README › Offline. Turn airplane mode off again if the journey stops early.

actions.action: From the bitkit-docker checkout, run `./spark invoice 1000` (README › Local invoices) and note the invoice as <invoice>
Run `adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable` and wait 5 s
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeOffline", for up to 1 minute
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendOfflineError" is listed
Verify from a screenshot that a crossed-out cloud sits above the line, with one OK button below it
Verify Home is back: "WatchHomeBalance" is listed
Run `adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode disable`
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it no longer lists "WatchHomeOffline", for up to 1 minute, then verify "WatchSendOfflineError" and "WatchSendSending" are not listed
